brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at levels 0, 1, 2 forming two adjacent columns (piece:0,0,0/1/2 and piece:1,0,0/1/2) capped and bolted; 240mm total height (3 storeys x 80mm).

4x notch drawer frames: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (level0 FM), notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (level0 MF), notch:1#0,1#notch1 (level1), notch:2#0,1#notch1 (level2) – each spans between the two columns with pull-out drawer.

finish.summary: Built a 3-storey (levels 0-2) two-column cabinet with 4 notch drawers bridging the columns – one drawer per available notch position plus an extra at ground level, exceeding the three-drawer minimum.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
